meta.title: Shift In The World's Unitary Matrix - 1

units.rawText: Amidst the darkness, light appears.
units.displayText: Amidst the darkness, light appears.

spans.text: Amidst the darkness, light appears.

units.rawText: It resolves into countless points which rain down like marbles and bounce back up, bringing color back into my vision.
units.displayText: It resolves into countless points which rain down like marbles and bounce back up, bringing color back into my vision.

spans.text: It resolves into countless points which rain down like marbles and bounce back up, bringing color back into my vision.

units.rawText: Owowow...
units.displayText: Owowow...

spans.text: Owowow...

units.rawText: My head feels like it's about to explode.
units.displayText: My head feels like it's about to explode.

spans.text: My head feels like it's about to explode.

units.rawText: With my hand on my forehead, I slowly open my eyes.
units.displayText: With my hand on my forehead, I slowly open my eyes.

spans.text: With my hand on my forehead, I slowly open my eyes.

units.rawText: Is this... the other world line?
units.displayText: Is this... the other world line?

spans.text: Is this... the other world line?

units.rawText: In that case, show me your changed face, o world!
units.displayText: In that case, show me your changed face, o world!

spans.text: In that case, show me your changed face, o world!

units.rawText: How about this—Super Move: Hyper Geyser!
units.displayText: How about this—Super Move: Hyper Geyser!

spans.text: How about this—Super Move: Hyper Geyser!

units.rawText: Whoa, that was close!
units.displayText: Whoa, that was close!

spans.text: Whoa, that was close!

units.rawText: What?! How did you even manage to dodge that? That's so cheap!
units.displayText: What?! How did you even manage to dodge that? That's so cheap!

spans.text: What?! How did you even manage to dodge that? That's so cheap!

units.rawText: Whew, that was nearly game over for me. Don't lose your cool, Anna-tan~
units.displayText: Whew, that was nearly game over for me. Don't lose your cool, Anna-tan~

spans.text: Whew, that was nearly game over for me. Don't lose your cool, Anna-tan~

units.rawText: Looks like Daru and Green-Haired Loli are playing Street Fracas 51.
units.displayText: Looks like Daru and Green-Haired Loli are playing Street Fracas 51.

spans.text: Looks like Daru and Green-Haired Loli are playing Street Fracas 51.

units.rawText: I look around. My surroundings have gone from the FGL to the electronics store.
units.displayText: I look around. My surroundings have gone from the FGL to the electronics store.

spans.text: I look around. My surroundings have gone from the FGL to the electronics store.

units.rawText: For a moment I think that time has turned backward—but that's impossible. I glance at the time on the system display; it's almost the same as the time when he D-mail was sent; 16:15.
units.displayText: For a moment I think that time has turned backward—but that's impossible. I glance at the time on the system display; it's almost the same as the time when he D-mail was sent; 16:15.

spans.text: For a moment I think that time has turned backward—but that's impossible. I glance at the time on the system display; it's almost the same as the time when he D-mail was sent; 16:15.

units.rawText: In that case, what exactly had taken place?
units.displayText: In that case, what exactly had taken place?

spans.text: In that case, what exactly had taken place?

units.rawText: You're wide open, Anna-tan—Take my Raving Storm!
units.displayText: You're wide open, Anna-tan—Take my Raving Storm!

spans.text: You're wide open, Anna-tan—Take my Raving Storm!

units.rawText: Like hell I'm going to let you follow up on that!
units.displayText: Like hell I'm going to let you follow up on that!

spans.text: Like hell I'm going to let you follow up on that!

units.rawText: Ohhh! Well done, Anna-tan. Both parties' HP bars are depleted (not sure if there's enough left for one more punch). I won't hold back anymore from now on!
units.displayText: Ohhh! Well done, Anna-tan. Both parties' HP bars are depleted (not sure if there's enough left for one more punch). I won't hold back anymore from now on!

spans.text: Ohhh! Well done, Anna-tan. Both parties' HP bars are depleted (not sure if there's enough left for one more punch). I won't hold back anymore from now on!

units.rawText: I told you, my name is Antonina! —Oh crap!
units.displayText: I told you, my name is Antonina! —Oh crap!

spans.text: I told you, my name is Antonina! —Oh crap!

units.rawText: Looks like their showdown has reached its climax. Considering they're deaf to all outsiders now, I might as well wait until the game ends before asking them for details.
units.displayText: Looks like their showdown has reached its climax. Considering they're deaf to all outsiders now, I might as well wait until the game ends before asking them for details.

spans.text: Looks like their showdown has reached its climax. Considering they're deaf to all outsiders now, I might as well wait until the game ends before asking them for details.

units.rawText: <size=40>Humph, I've got a read on your patterns... Let's settle this once and for all!</size>
units.displayText: Humph, I've got a read on your patterns... Let's settle this once and for all!

spans.text: Humph, I've got a read on your patterns... Let's settle this once and for all!

units.rawText: <size=40>Hoho, you're on!</size>
